description: This Java source file defines the class `HttpPushValidator`, which is responsible for validating HTTP Push connection configurations within a broader connectivity framework. It includes methods for verifying URI schemes, target addresses, HTTP methods, and parallelism settings, ensuring that the connection adheres to expected standards and supported configurations.

classes.name: HttpPushValidator
classes.description: A final class that extends `AbstractProtocolValidator`, providing specific validation logic for HTTP Push connections, including URI scheme validation, method checks, header and target address validation, and parallelism configuration validation.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Factory method to create a new instance of `HttpPushValidator`.

methods.name: type
methods.description: Returns the type of connection this validator supports, which is `HTTP_PUSH`.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Performs validation on the connection object, headers, and actor system, including URI scheme validation, source/target configs, payload mappings, and parallelism.

methods.name: validateSource
methods.description: Ensures that the connection does not have any source, as per the connection type, and throws an exception if invalid.

methods.name: validateTarget
methods.description: Validates target configuration, including header mappings, address templates, and target address format.

methods.name: validateTargetAddress
methods.description: Parses and validates the target address, specifically checking the HTTP method and path format.

methods.name: validateHttpMethod
methods.description: Checks if the provided HTTP method name is supported, throwing an exception if not.

methods.name: validateParallelism
methods.description: Validates the parallelism configuration parameter, ensuring it is a positive integer if set.

methods.name: parallelismValidationFailed
methods.description: Creates an exception indicating invalid parallelism configuration.

methods.name: isSecureScheme
methods.description: Static method to determine if a URI scheme is considered secure (HTTPS).
